_comment: Two objects per grid; the LARGEST object is recoloured in place to a FIXED colour (2) that appears on no input object (smaller object unchanged, grid unchanged). Isolates a colour-source reading the recolor family cannot yet name: the new colour is a constant agreed across the examples, NOT color_of(some other object). The selected object's own colour VARIES across pairs (3,5,7) and the constant 2 is absent from every input, so neither the value-keyed legacy color map nor the existing source-selector (color_of(another object)) fits. selector=largest, source=constant(2). Value-agnostic the way constant_output is: the constant is fitted from the example outputs at solve time, never hand-coded.
